india.one_line: India pushes AI growth with major funding push and new governance guidelines.

themes.title: AM Intelligence seeks $3 billion
themes.text: AM Intelligence plans to raise up to $3 billion, including bonds, loans and a $300 million advance, to purchase Nvidia’s Vera Rubin AI chips.

stories.headline: AM Intelligence seeks up to $3 billion to fund Nvidia Vera Rubin chip purchase

themes.title: New AI governance frameworks announced
themes.text: MeitY released a DEPA handbook to enable trusted data sharing for AI training, while TRAI issued draft guidelines requiring telecoms to classify AI systems, obtain board approval and report incidents.

stories.headline: MeitY releases DEPA handbook to enable trusted data sharing for AI training
TRAI drafts AI policy framework requiring board approval and incident reporting for telecoms
